text:
jenn_support: FYI customer (private VPC) says invoice is ~12% higher than the dashboard for Jan billing period. Agent v2.3.1 deployed on their nodes. They reported a "time jump" around 2026-01-12 03:12 UTC and an offline buffer flush right after. Can infra check if this caused duplicated meter events?

raj_infra: thanks. which customer and which host? any quick logs or S3 paths you can share?

jenn_support: tenant_id=tenant-89, host=vm-app-12 (eu-west-1), s3 prefix: s3://redwood-metering-prod/tenant-89/ingest/2026-01-12/. Agent logs attached below (redacted):

[INFO] 2026-01-12T03:11:58Z meter-agent: seq=298712 client=tenant-89 ts=1705062718 event_type=token_count size=24
[INFO] 2026-01-12T03:12:01Z meter-agent: seq=298713 client=tenant-89 ts=1705062721 event_type=token_count size=18
[WARN] 2026-01-12T03:12:05Z systemd-timesyncd: time change detected: jump backward 3600s
[INFO] 2026-01-12T03:12:10Z buffer: offline flush started, file=s3://.../part-0003.gz events=512
[INFO] 2026-01-12T03:12:12Z meter-agent: seq=298714 client=tenant-89 ts=1705059128 event_type=token_count size=20

jenn_support: note seq increased but ts went back ~1 hour (NTP reset). We suspect replayed events landed with older timestamps but ingestion dedupe uses (client_id, ts, hash) so duplicates were not deduped.

alex_ops: that matches a known gap. If the agent replayed buffered events after the clock jump, seq ids may repeat across boundary or be monotonic but ts overlap can cause ingestion to treat them as new. We should confirm by checking unique seq counts in the raw objects. Quick checks:

# list objects for timeframe
aws s3 ls s3://redwood-metering-prod/tenant-89/ingest/2026-01-12/ --recursive | grep part-0003

# scan gz for duplicate seq ids (streaming)
python -c "import gzip,sys,json; seen=set();
for f in sys.argv[1:]:
  with gzip.open(f,'rt') as fh:
    for line in fh:
      j=json.loads(line)
      key=(j.get('client'), j.get('seq'))
      if key in seen: print('DUP',j.get('seq'))
      else: seen.add(key)" s3_downloaded_part-0003.gz

raj_infra: can you paste the agent /debug/state output? need last_persisted_seq and buffer state.

jenn_support: pasted minimal /debug/state:
{
  "client":"tenant-89",
  "last_seq_sent":"298714",
  "buffered_events":482,
  "last_fs_sync":"2026-01-12T03:12:09Z",
  "clock_monotonic":false
}

metering-bot: alert: ingest-dedupe-anomaly tenant=tenant-89 window=01h duplicates_detected=312 threshold=50

alex_ops: immediate mitigation: 1) run a dedupe job over that prefix using (client, seq) as the dedupe key; 2) issue provisional credit for duplicates > X tokens; 3) patch agent to persist per-client last_seq on durable storage and to attach a monotonic replay-id to buffered events. I'll draft the agent patch.

raj_infra: suggestion for dedupe SQL (clickhouse example):
SELECT client, seq, anyHeavy(event_hash) as representative, sum(tokens) as tokens, count() as total_events
FROM metering_raw
WHERE path LIKE '%tenant-89/2026-01-12%'
GROUP BY client, seq
HAVING count()>1
ORDER BY tokens DESC

alex_ops: repro steps to validate locally:
1) run agent docker image: docker run --rm -e CLIENT=tenant-89 redwood/meter-agent:v2.3.1
2) send events with increasing seq, then `sudo date -s '1 hour ago'` inside container to force timejump
3) let agent buffer ~500 events, `sudo date -s 'now'` to restore, trigger flush to local s3 emulator (minio)
4) run the python duplicate scanner above against the objects.

jenn_support: I'll open a billing escalation (billing#3421) to request provisional credit and include the duplicate counts. Can infra prioritize the dedupe job patch and a short-term pipeline rule: prefer dedupe by (client, seq) when seq present.

raj_infra: agreed. I'll queue a dedupe map-reduce job and add a short-term ingest patch to use seq when available. Also will add a health check: if system clock jumps >120s and buffered_events>100 -> emit critical and stop replay until operator review.

alex_ops: long-term: agent should also include monotonic_replay_id + persisted last_seq per client and sign events with HMAC to avoid replay attacks and accidental duplicates. I'll put a PR up tomorrow.

jenn_support: customer notified, asked for ETA on credit and fix. thanks team.

raj_infra: :thumbsup:
